title: A lookup prints not found for a client-rendered page: the soft-404 test compares its empty text with an empty made-up page
goal: A source whose page has no extractable text (a client-rendered techcommunity.microsoft.com page: the fetch gives one newline, as its made-up sibling's does) is no soft-404: factdiff.detect_source in lookup mode asks no soft-404 test of a text with no words, and the revalidation prints the lines citing it as source-dated only or not checked, never not found, so freshness figures of run freshness no longer count them as not_found; the repro exits 0.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import factdiff, kbfacts; u = [x for x in kbfacts.units() if (x['path'], x['line']) == ('public/auth/flows.csv', 10)][0]; r = factdiff.revalidate([{'path': u['path'], 'line': u['line'], 'key': kbfacts.fact_key(u['text']), 'text': u['text'], 'ids': ['S1203']}]); sys.exit(1 if r['lines'][('public/auth/flows.csv', 10)]['outcome'] == 'not found' else 0)
